title: Contested Logistics and the "Last Unmanned Mile" | Rune Technologies News
summary: A discussion featuring David Tuttle from Rune Technologies explores how military logistics must adapt when supply lines face enemy threats in potential Pacific conflicts.
body_markdown:
War of the Rocks covered Rune Technologies by Jonathan Panter in a piece titled “Contested Logistics and the "Last Unmanned Mile".” A discussion featuring David Tuttle from Rune Technologies explores how military logistics must adapt when supply lines face enemy threats in potential Pacific conflicts.


Read the full article[here](https://warontherocks.com/cogs-of-war/contested-logistics-and-the-last-unmanned-mile/) .
